articles.title: City Launches Green Transport Initiative
articles.author: Ava Patel
articles.description: The city plans to expand bike lanes, add more electric buses, and improve public transport access to reduce traffic congestion and lower pollution levels.
key_points: 50 new charging stations for electric vehicles will be installed across the city.
Free electric shuttle services will be introduced in busy downtown areas.
The initiative aims to cut carbon emissions by 20% over the next five years.

articles.title: Tech Startups Focus on AI Education Programs
articles.author: Daniel Kim
articles.description: Several start-ups are partnering with schools to provide AI literacy courses, helping students build practical skills for the digital future.
key_points: Programs will include coding workshops and AI ethics training for young learners.
Local colleges will offer internship pathways for students completing the courses.
The initiative is designed to close the skills gap in emerging technology fields.

articles.title: Local Farmers Market Expands to Support Small Businesses
articles.author: Mia Rodriguez
articles.description: The community market is growing to provide more space for local vendors, sustainable products, and neighborhood events that encourage healthy living.
key_points: New stalls will feature handmade goods, organic produce, and artisan foods.
Weekend workshops will focus on sustainable farming and healthy cooking.
Organizers expect higher foot traffic and stronger local economic activity.
